entries.what: Slept until 9, then walked the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loosely before heading to Ruel Road; started the 1 p.m. ten-hour swing in the IT cage fixing frozen handhelds.
entries.outcome: Cleared a short queue of scanner tickets before the night handoff.

entries.what: Updated her RMA sheet during the evening rush and covered Greg's old vendor tickets.
entries.outcome: Sent six dead scanners back to the vendor.

entries.what: Got home after 11:30, ate leftover rice with Iris and did a few subnetting drills before bed.
entries.outcome: Finished one practice set around 1 a.m.

entries.what: Slept in, then went through Iris's shared budget sheet and brainstormed gift ideas for the Nov 15 anniversary follow-up, wanting something that fits Iris's love of lists.
entries.outcome: Settled on a short list of list-themed gifts to choose from.

entries.what: Tuesday shift on Ruel Road; trained Bao on scanner trigger boards from 3 to 5.
entries.outcome: Bao swapped two trigger boards on his own.

entries.what: Late-night red-beep stretch as pickers fell behind rate; Carla texted about dead scanners.
entries.outcome: Swapped out a dozen units from the cage.

entries.what: Midday study session with the practice-test app and tabbed guide before shift.
entries.outcome: Hit around 80% on a port-numbers set.

entries.what: Worked the swing shift in the cage, tracking scanner RMAs and handling scheduling.
entries.outcome: Handled the handoff notes herself again.

entries.what: Came home late and played a bit on her desktop before sleeping.
entries.outcome: Logged off after one match.

entries.what: Quick morning at home, then to Ruel Road; Thursday training block with Bao from 3 to 5.
entries.outcome: Bao handled a battery swap batch alone.

entries.what: Iris's Thursday sushi was waiting when she got home past 11:30.
entries.outcome: Ate late and talked briefly about the gift plan.

entries.what: Did subnetting drills before bed.
entries.outcome: Missed only a few problems.

entries.what: Friday shift; grabbed Taquería Colima for dinner break.
entries.outcome: Ate tacos in the break room near the cage.

entries.what: Fixed a batch of frozen handhelds as the overtime week wound down.
entries.outcome: Cage count dropped under the peak average.

entries.what: Drove home after 11:30 along quiet Ruel Road.
entries.outcome: Got to bed around 1.

entries.what: Slept until 9, then walked the marsh boardwalk Saturday morning, avoiding the slick planks.
entries.outcome: Short walk, cut it early because of wet boards.

entries.what: Spent the afternoon at her parents' fourplex off Vinca fixing a printer, with the food drive crowds around town.
entries.outcome: Printer working again.

entries.what: Evening at home with Iris, planning December trip savings.
entries.outcome: Confirmed the $1,200 cushion is nearly there.

entries.what: Slow Sunday morning, then a long practice exam session with the study guide.
entries.outcome: Scored near 80%.

entries.what: Helped with groceries and laundry in the unit with Iris.
entries.outcome: Got the week's meal prep done.

entries.what: Sunday night co-op game with her online squad as packetloss_.
entries.outcome: Won a long run, then slept.
